title: Governance Drift: Reproducibility Package
description: Manuscript source, closed-world detector study, independent no-join baseline, canonical results, and a repeated bounded Kubernetes/GitOps laboratory for Governance Drift. Version 1.5.0 retains 538/540 detections with 538/538 exact class sets conditional on detection in the primary live campaign; adds 45/45 exact compound-vector observations; and adds a 1,800-second benign soak with zero substantive or epistemic alarms in 4,680 polls. The no-join baseline diagnoses 9/12 scenario sets versus 12/12 for the admitted-basis join. These bounded results establish realizability and within-laboratory behavior, not natural occurrence, field prevalence, production effectiveness, or transport reliability.
